steps.title: Sentence completion - connectors and method
steps.intro: The link between the parts of the sentence decides the answer. Know the connectors by what they do.

English connectors

tables.title: The method
head: Step
What to do
rows: Shrink the sentence to its skeleton: cross out noise, rewrite hard parts briefly
Read with an option in place - never with holes
Plug in by similar beginnings; predict how the sentence should go on
Parts contradict each other → eliminate (the sentence’s logic, not world knowledge)
It fits → mark it and move on; don’t check the rest

tips: Hypothetical: what really happened is the reverse of what is written.
Had it not been for X, Y would… → because of X, not Y.
A hunch may choose which option to try first - never mark without checking.
